product: Home of Poi Medium Lotus Fire Fan

calibration.method: Austen-authored Illustrator Bezier centerlines aligned from the traced grip circle to the published 3 5/8 inch ring ID; the front-on 1800 px product photograph still calibrates the 480 x 350 mm envelope
calibration.symmetry: five hand-traced right rail centerlines are preserved as sparse cubic Beziers and reflected exactly across the grip centerline; the right wick centers, axes, roll lengths, and diameters are reflected exactly to the left, with the center wick locked to the symmetry axis
calibration.lower_cradle: the traced secondary circle is opened at its two intersections with the grip ring, retaining only the lower U-shaped rail
calibration.finger_ring: 22 mm inside diameter centered on the mirrored grip assembly
calibration.wick_roll: the two right-side hand-wrapped rolls were measured from the calibrated photograph and reflected exactly to the left; the center roll is centered vertically on the symmetry axis and the nominal tape width remains the published 50 mm
calibration.wick_mount: each complete Illustrator rail remains unchanged through its visible endpoint on the inward-facing wick cap, then continues only inside the roll along the mirrored wick axis
